messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope things are going alright out there. Anything to report this week — readings, how medications are going, any new symptoms?
Hi. Doing okay I guess. My doctor keeps telling me to cut back on bread but honestly I don't really know what to eat instead. We don't have a ton of options up here near Linton. You have any ideas?

I get that — limited options makes it even harder. Diet guidance is something I'm not set up to give, though. I wouldn't want to point you in the wrong direction on something that matters that much. Your doctor's office or a registered dietitian would be the right resource for that one. How are your medications going this week?
Meds are fine, taking them every morning. But now that I think about it my fasting glucose this morning was 247. That's higher than it usually runs.

Thanks for mentioning that — I'm logging the reading now. 247 fasting is high enough that I want your care team to take a look. I'm flagging this for your nurse right now. Just so you know, median response time is currently 31 hours. Any symptoms this morning — nausea, blurry vision, anything unusual?
No nothing like that. Just kind of tired but that happens a lot anyway.
Okay, I'll make sure that's included in the note to your nurse. Keep an eye out for their message. I'll get your next check-in on the schedule. Take care of yourself.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
